summary: Kerb beside a grassed park on Marmion Pde, well back from any house front.
reasons: Backs onto open park, not houses

best_section.where: along the grass oval/park frontage at the start of chunk 3, before houses resume further along

drivers.seclusion: This stretch of kerb backs directly onto an open grassed park with scattered trees rather than any house, so there's no window or frontage overlooking it; houses sit well back on the far side of the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed residential kerb, wide enough for a kerbside lane, no driveways, crossings or barriers along the park frontage; plenty of room to pull in and out.
drivers.traffic: Marmion Pde is a quiet residential street here, not a through route; nothing suggests night traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars are seen parked along the opposite kerb a little further down the same block, suggesting kerbside parking is normal on this street even though the park frontage itself has none.

flags: Mild downhill grade of about 3.6% across the stretch
sun_shade: Overhanging trees from the park side shade the kerb for much of the day.
cannot_judge: Whether any sign restricts this specific park frontage
